items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: The rim is a copy of my normal Bach 1-1/4 mouthpiece trumpet.

ctx.x: But when you just a couple of minutes ago you were doing the solfeggio and you were moving your — you weren’t playing the piano, you were moving your trumpet fingers. Okay. Do you think that —

Let me use another tool that I got here, because I got different ones you know, I’ve got different ones with different — hold on one second. Yes, I’ve got another horn here which is a lot larger. The bell, the bore, they’re very big, extra large, and an extra large mouthpiece as well you know. It’s a kind of inside it’s a kind of a French horn mouthpiece. The rim is a copy of my normal Bach 1-1/4 mouthpiece trumpet. But inside it’s completely different you know, it’s a big hole, very deep, and you can see, you…
